title: Industrial Nexus: First Steps
summary: Set up the first safe Industrial Nexus loop before widening the route.

blocks.title: Start Small
blocks.body: Build one small processing chain completely before making a factory. Confirm power, input rate, output room, and a way to respond when it stalls.

blocks.title: First Clean Win
blocks.body: Begin with one processing chain that you can explain end to end: input, machine, fuel or power, output, storage, and failure symptom.

blocks.title: Before You Expand
blocks.body: Name the goal, the exit, and the resource or signal that proves Industrial Nexus is helping. If any of those are vague, keep the next run shorter.

blocks.title: Ready Check
blocks.body: Before moving on, confirm the first setup step is repeatable and safe enough to do again.
